title: MedSentry: Understanding and Mitigating Safety Risks in Medical LLM Multi-Agent Systems
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (MedSentry) specifically designed to evaluate medical safety and ethics. It utilizes the American Medical Association’s (AMA) Principles of Medical Ethics as a primary metric for its Evaluator Agent to grade multi-agent system responses. Furthermore, it explicitly includes 'Medical Ethics' as a core component of its evaluation pipeline and addresses threat categories related to unethical medical advice.
